# bynku

> bynku is a simple personal finance app for households: track income and spending across your cycle, plan fixed costs and loans, allocate what's left to savings goals, and get plain-language coaching.

bynku helps people see their money in one place — recurring income, fixed monthly costs, loans and debts, variable spending, and savings projects — and turn the leftover surplus into a plan. It includes a loan payoff simulator (avalanche and snowball), spending benchmarks, shareable financial snapshots, and an AI coach that explains finance concepts in easy language. Available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, German and French.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What bynku is, who it's for, and how the budgeting cycle works.
- [Privacy](/privacy): How financial data is stored, kept household-scoped, exported and erased (GDPR).
- [Guides](/guides): Practical budgeting guides for couples, families and small businesses.
- [Budgeting for couples](/guides/budgeting-for-couples): Fair income-based bill splitting, shared buckets, and one safe-to-spend number.
- [Family budgeting](/guides/family-budgeting): Baselines, sinking funds for lumpy costs, and involving children.
- [Small business cash flow](/guides/small-business-cash-flow): Owner pay, tax/VAT reserves, burn and runway for freelancers and SMEs.
